get.description: Export a catalog in CSV (Comma Separated Values). Specific parameters are described here

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: Sets the field delimiter of the CSV export

parameters.name: list_separator
parameters.description: Sets the separator character used for multivalued strings

parameters.name: quote_all
parameters.description: Set it to true to force quoting all strings, i.e. surrounding all strings with quote characters

parameters.name: with_bom
parameters.description:
Set it to true to force the first characters of the CSV file to be a Unicode Byte Order Mask (0xFEFF). It usually makes Excel correctly open the output CSV file without warning.
**Warning:** the default value of this parameter is `false` in v2.0 and `true` starting with v2.1
